title: Remodeling Ca(2+) dynamics by targeting a promising E-box containing G-quadruplex at ORAI1 promoter in triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Chatterjee, Oishika; Jana, Jagannath; Panda, Suman; Dutta, Anindya; Sharma, Akshay; Saurav, Suman; Motiani, Rajender K; Weisz, Klaus; Chatterjee, Subhrangsu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ORAI1启动子区含E-box的G-四链体结构及其与转录因子Zeb1的互作，通过NMR和ChIP等实验手段揭示其调控机制，虽涉及TF-DNA结合但缺乏AI或物理模拟建模方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移的文献。
abstract: ORAI1 is an intrinsic component of store-operated calcium entry (SOCE) that strictly regulates Ca(2+) influx in most non-excitable cells. ORAI1 is overexpressed in a wide variety of cancers, and its signal transduction has been associated with chemotherapy resistance. There is extensive proteomic interaction of ORAI1 with other channels and effectors, resulting in various altered phenotypes. However, the transcription regulation of ORAI1 is not well understood. We have found a putative G-quadruplex (G4) motif, ORAI1-Pu, in the upstream promoter region of the gene, having regulatory functions. High-resolution 3-D NMR structure elucidation suggests that ORAI1-Pu is a stable parallel-stranded G4, having a long 8-nt loop imparting dynamics without affecting the structural stability. The protruded loop further houses an E-box motif that provides a docking site for transcription factors like Zeb1. The G4 structure was also endogenously observed using Chromatin Immunoprecipitation (ChIP) with anti-G4 antibody (BG4) in the MDA-MB-231 cell line overexpressing ORAI1. Ligand-mediated stabilization suggested that the stabilized G4 represses transcription in cancer cell line MDA-MB-231. Downregulation of transcription further led to decreased Ca(2+) entry by the SOCE pathway, as observed by live-cell Fura-2 Ca(2+) imaging.
abstract_zh: ORAI1是储库操纵性钙内流（store-operated calcium entry, SOCE）的内在组成部分，严格调控大多数非兴奋性细胞中的Ca(2+)内流。ORAI1在多种癌症中过表达，其信号转导与化疗耐药性相关。ORAI1与其他通道和效应器存在广泛的蛋白质组学相互作用，导致多种表型改变。然而，ORAI1的转录调控机制尚不明确。我们在该基因的上游启动子区域发现了一个推定的G-四链体（G-quadruplex, G4）基序ORAI1-Pu，其具有调控功能。高分辨率三维NMR结构解析表明，ORAI1-Pu是一种稳定的平行链G4，具有一个长8核苷酸的环，该环赋予动态特性而不影响结构稳定性。突出的环进一步包含一个E-box基序，为Zeb1等转录因子提供对接位点。在过表达ORAI1的MDA-MB-231细胞系中，通过染色质免疫沉淀（Chromatin Immunoprecipitation, ChIP）结合抗G4抗体（BG4）也内源性地观察到了该G4结构。配体介导的稳定化表明，稳定的G4在癌细胞系MDA-MB-231中抑制转录。转录下调进一步导致SOCE途径的Ca(2+)内流减少，这通过活细胞Fura-2 Ca(2+)成像观察到。
